stageRail.title: Stages and services
stageRail.body: Stages run left to right from spooling to test packs. NDE, Tracking and Flanges serve several stages, so they sit beside them. Your project stays selected wherever you go.

moduleTabs.title: Pages of this module
moduleTabs.body: Every page of the current module you can open is a tab here. Use the stage rail above to move to another module.

workContext.title: Selected object
workContext.body: The spool or test pack you picked stays selected as you move between pages that work on it. Clear it to see everything again.

attention.title: Start with what is open
attention.body: Each row counts open work in this project and opens the list where it is done, already narrowed to it.

processMap.title: One map, one navigation
processMap.body: The cards are the same stages and services you move between inside modules. Open a card to work in it.

currentProject.title: Open or return
currentProject.body: Return keeps the project you are in. Opening another project switches every page to it and drops the previous project's searches and selections.

projectSearch.title: Find a project
projectSearch.body: Search matches the project code, title, owner, contractor and contract number.

rftBlocker.title: Open the blocker
rftBlocker.body: Each open item links to the screen where it is resolved, with this spool already selected. Back on that screen returns here.

rftTable.title: Ready for Test is derived
rftTable.body: It opens once Welded / Bolted and Supported are recorded and no NDE obligation or PWHT requirement is open; no screen sets it by hand. Material columns count evidence from either phase.

ndeRecord.title: Record a result
ndeRecord.body: Only an issued obligation takes a result. A rejected result needs a defect code before it can be recorded.

traceInput.title: Heat / trace numbers
traceInput.body: Material Check completes once every ident code carries a trace number the PML accepts. Why it cannot be recorded yet is shown under the table.

rftBlocker2.title: Resolve an open criterion
rftBlocker2.body: Each open criterion links to where it is resolved, with this spool already selected. Ready for Test itself is derived and never set by hand.

spoolStepper.title: The spool's own steps
spoolStepper.body: Every step of the selected spool with its dates, in process order. The step it needs next opens by default; open any other to review or record it.

tpSpoolStatus.title: Spools of this pack
tpSpoolStatus.body: A spool that is not Ready for Test links to its readiness and to its open NDE work. Back returns to this pack.
